name: Alloa
source:
Artificial intelligence class D. One of the four droid subordinates that do mainly construction, repair, and transportation. 

It is possible that the four of them are based on the four main characters in the anime "Lucky Star". This one appears to be based on Konata.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%83%AB%E3%83%BC%E3%83%B3%E3%83%AD%E3%82%AA%E3%83%89#.E5.9C.B0.E7.90.83.E5.9C.8F_.E5.A4.AA.E9.99.BD.E7.B3.BB.E9.80.A3.E9.82.A6]the Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
